facts.fact: The page states that 11.1% of business profiles are unclaimed on Google Business Profile, without naming a source for the figure.
facts.quote: an astonishing **11.1% of profiles** are just sitting there unclaimed.

facts.fact: The page says, citing Google's data, that fully fleshed-out Google Business Profiles get 7x more clicks.
facts.quote: fully fleshed-out profiles get **7x more clicks** and are seen as **2.7x more credible**.

facts.fact: The page claims that businesses not optimized on Google Maps are essentially invisible to nearly nine out of ten potential customers, without citing a source.
facts.quote: you're essentially invisible to nearly nine out of ten potential customers.

facts.fact: Adwave recommends that a Google Business Profile have at least 15 high-quality photos, and says such a gallery gets far more clicks and calls.
facts.quote: A profile with a robust gallery, we recommend at least **15** high-quality photos, gets far more clicks and calls.

facts.fact: Adwave advises posting at least one new Google Post per week to keep a Business Profile fresh.
facts.quote: Aim for at least one new post a week to keep your profile fresh and feed Google's algorithm with positive activity signals.

facts.fact: Adwave states that Name, Address, and Phone number (NAP) details must be 100% identical across every local citation listing.
facts.quote: Making sure your **Name, Address, and Phone number (NAP)** are **100% identical** across every single one of these listings is non-negotiable.

facts.fact: Adwave describes Google Posts as free mini-billboards that appear on a Business Profile in Search and Maps.
facts.quote: Google Posts are like free mini-billboards that show up right on your Business Profile in Search and Maps.

facts.fact: Adwave describes Google's Prominence as an important ranking factor tied to how well-known a business is, built from customer reviews, photos, and Google Posts.
facts.quote: build what Google calls **Prominence**, an important ranking factor tied to how well-known your business is

facts.fact: Adwave states that responding to all reviews, both positive and negative, is non-negotiable for local businesses.
Adwave says its platform lets local businesses run broadcast-quality TV ads on channels including Hulu, ESPN, and NBC without a film crew or a giant budget.
facts.quote: Their platform gives local businesses the power to run broadcast-quality TV ads on major channels like Hulu, ESPN, and NBC

facts.fact: The page states that TV advertising was long assumed to be reserved for massive corporations with six-figure marketing budgets.
facts.quote: TV advertising felt like it was reserved for massive corporations with six-figure marketing budgets.

facts.fact: The page says ranking for competitive Google Maps searches takes consistent work over several months.
facts.quote: Getting there takes consistent work over several months.

facts.fact: The page says businesses should make their hours, phone number, and address 100% accurate on their Google Business Profile.
facts.quote: making sure your hours, phone number, and address are **100% accurate**

facts.fact: The page says service area businesses can define their service area by listing exact cities, zip codes, or counties, and can hide their physical address from the public.
facts.quote: You’ll choose to hide your physical address (which is likely your home) from the public. Then, you'll specifically define your service area. You can list the exact cities, zip codes, or counties
